features.featureTitle: Update the registration submission flow so that the FINAL SUBMIT action on the Payment page first saves all registration data (including the uploaded payment screenshot) to the backend. Only display the 'Registration Successful' success page if the backend save returns a success result. If the backend call fails or returns an error, do NOT navigate to the success page — instead show an inline error message on the Payment page.

Implement an admin login screen at /admin that requires entry of Username and Password before granting access to the dashboard. Hard-code the valid credentials as Username: VibECX-2K26 and Password: VibECX@2K26 (validated on the backend via the existing adminLogin endpoint). If credentials are incorrect, display the message 'Invalid Username or Password'. The dashboard content must not render until login is successful.

Build or update the AdminDashboard component to display three stat cards at the top (Total Registrations, Total Participants, Total Revenue) and a table below listing all registrations with columns: Name, College, Department, Phone, Event Type, Members, Amount, Timestamp, and Payment Screenshot. The Payment Screenshot cell must show a clickable thumbnail that opens the full image in a preview (lightbox or new tab). The table must be sorted latest-first and reflect any new registrations immediately after page load/refresh.

Style the admin login screen and dashboard using the same dark theme as the rest of the site (dark backgrounds, orange-gold accents). The layout must be clean, professional, minimally animated, and fully responsive on mobile and desktop.
